svg.aria-label: How we work: 1. Free intro-call. We discuss your situation and open questions. Free and non-binding. 2. Secure data transfer. You send your data securely via our cloud. 3. Preparation and analysis of transaction data. Together we review your transaction data and identify tax-relevant facts. 4. Preparation of tax reports. You receive a clear report of all taxable events. 5. Tax filing. We prepare the tax return and submit it to the relevant tax authority. 6. Communication with tax authorities. We handle the communication with the tax authorities for you.
